title: The Old Dam
summary: Hold the line while Hisame breaks Iwao's barrier, then face him.

lines: Emberwood again. You should have stayed home and let the stone settle.
Iwao. You were never a bad man. Only a stubborn one.
Kagerou gave me a reason. The academy gave me a door. Guess which one I kept.
The array wakes at the top of the hour. Stop me if you can. Clones, rise!
His barrier is tied to the array. I need time to cut the seal lines. Hold them off!

beats.text: Hold until Hisame breaks the barrier

lines: The barrier's down! Iwao, it's over.
Not while I'm standing. Earth, and now water. Kagerou taught me that much.

phases.say: Water now. Let's see your circle.
Enough! I'll bury you under the dam!

lines: ...He told me the Nue would make us something the academy couldn't throw away.
And what did it make you?
A man who fought children at a dam.
The unsealing is at the Shrine of the Five Winds, at the new moon. Two nights from now. Stop him. I couldn't.
He comes with me to the Watch. They'll want to hear all of it.
